# Real-world references (style only; no real documents copied)

- **Factory heads (SPC chart per filling head):** Western Electric Statistical Quality Control Handbook (1956), rules 1-4; NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, section 6.3 (Shewhart individuals charts); rotary filler per-valve fill-weight monitoring as shown in checkweigher/SPC software screens.
- **Fiber v3 (patching as-built):** ANSI/TIA-568.3-D (MTP/MPO polarity methods A, B, C); data-centre structured-cabling as-built / patch schedules (e.g. Corning and CommScope MTP trunk polarity guides).
- **Brain (sleep study + EEG):** AASM Manual for the Scoring of Sleep and Associated Events (stage definitions, WASO, REM latency); standard PSG summary report layout; longitudinal bipolar ("double banana") montage, phase reversal localisation (e.g. ACNS guidelines).
- **Cross sections:** FHWA Western Federal Lands sample cross-section sheets (highways.dot.gov/federal-lands/design/plan-prep/wfl/samples/cross-section.pdf); Caltrans Plans Preparation Manual examples.
- **Tennis 3D (received):** Hawk-Eye multi-camera triangulation (Owens, Harris & Stennett 2003); ITF Rules of Tennis, Rule 1 and Appendix I.
